item.title: Large felled tree close to the carriageway, 28th October
item.description:
A very large felled tree just off the carriageway is a danger to traffic heading away from Brockworth. It could do with a reflective bollard placing by it. A vehicle running into this massive lump would cause significant damage to the vehicle and occupants.

item.title: Lose and rattling metal cover, getting much worse and, 28th October
item.description:
The drain cover is outside 8 Shurdington Rd Leckhampton GL530JD and almost every car goes over it and rattles it very loudly. It's almost impossible to sleep at the front of my house at number 4 Shurdington Rd I can't have any grandchildren to sleep over now, please come out and repair it, kind regards John Robinson

item.title: Bridge looks on verge of collapse, 28th October
item.description:
Along the footpath besides Norman's Brook leading from the B4063, and within Brickhampton golf course, there is a small footbridge. Besides this there is also a much older brick tunnel structure that looks like it might once have supported a bridge. This looks like it is on the verge of collapse which would block the Brook and also potentially pose other dangers.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Cheltenham Road, Elmbridge, Gloucester
Report on FixMyStreet
